categories.name: Warewashing and kitchen hygiene
categories.description: Machine and manual warewashing for commercial kitchens: auto-dosed dishwasher detergent and rinse aid, heavy-duty potwash, and a decarbonising soak for pots and pans.

categories.name: Disinfection and sanitisation
categories.description: QAC and chlorine chemistry for surfaces and food-contact areas, a powder wash for salads and fruit, alcohol hand sanitiser, and an oxygen-based cleaner-disinfectant.

categories.name: Speciality products
categories.description: The jobs that need their own chemistry: descaling, ovens and grills, crockery destaining, and a caustic drain and fat-trap opener.

categories.name: Personal hygiene
categories.description: Germicidal handwash, perfumed or fragrance-free, and a shower gel. All dispenser-ready and used neat.

categories.name: Housekeeping, public areas and fitness centres
categories.description: Rooms, washrooms and public areas: glass, tiles and bathrooms, floor stripping and polishing, carpet shampoo, degreaser, air fresheners and furniture polish.

categories.name: Food, beverage and process hygiene
categories.description: Plant and process cleaning for dairy, beverage and food production: alkaline and acid CIP detergents, peracetic disinfection, a food-safe destainer and raw caustic.

categories.name: Laundry
categories.description: Commercial laundry, where Safuney supplies the products, the support and the training: one-shot and fully built detergent powders, boosters, bleaches, softener, sour, and the A. L. Wilson spotting range.

categories.name: Bactro biological range
categories.description: Bacterial and enzyme cleaners, liquid and tablet, for washrooms, drains, grease traps and urinals. They keep working between cleans.

categories.name: Cleaning equipment and consumables
categories.description: Scrubbing machines, vacuums, janitor carts, wringer buckets, mops, brooms, squeegees, gloves and paper dispensers — the kit that applies the chemistry.

products.name: SAF AUTOKLIN
products.shortDescription: Dishwasher and glasswasher machine liquid detergent, auto-dosed.
products.dilutionText: Auto-dosed to achieve at least 300 ppm for glasses and 600 ppm for dishes.

products.name: SAF AUTORINSE
products.shortDescription: Auto-dosed rinse additive and drying agent for spotless kitchenware and glasses.
products.dilutionText: Dosed at 2 ml per litre of rinse water.

dilutionGuidance.note: 2 ml per litre of rinse water.

products.name: SAF-GUARD HD
products.shortDescription: Heavy-duty concentrated warewash detergent and potwash.
products.dilutionText: From 1:10 for pots and pans to 1:50 for glasses.

products.name: SAF POT AND PAN
products.shortDescription: Decarbonising powder for soaking pots and pans. Effective for removing carbon soot from kitchen utensils.

products.name: SAF QUARTSAN
products.shortDescription: QAC-based sanitiser for surfaces and food-contact areas.
products.dilutionText: 10 ml in 1 litre of water, in spray bottles or sanitiser buckets.

dilutionGuidance.note: 10 ml in 1 litre of water, in spray bottles or sanitiser buckets.

products.name: SAF SALAD WASH
products.shortDescription: Powder chlorine-based cleaner for salads and fruit.
products.dilutionText: Soak fruit and vegetables in a 4 g/l solution in cold water, then rinse in potable water.

products.name: SAF BACTOSAN
products.shortDescription: General-purpose cleaner, disinfectant and deodoriser for washrooms, urinals, garbage rooms, bins and sanitary areas.
products.dilutionText: Use at 1:50 for cleaning, disinfection and deodorising.

products.name: SAFUNEY M511
products.shortDescription: Chlorine-based disinfectant and bleaching solution at 4% active chlorine.

products.name: SANITOUCH
products.shortDescription: Alcohol-based hand sanitiser, liquid or gel.

products.name: SAF STERIKLIN
products.shortDescription: Cleaner, degreaser and oxygen-based disinfectant.

products.name: LIMEKLIN

dilutionGuidance.note: Use neat or dilute according to the extent of scaling.

products.name: GREASE BUSTER
products.shortDescription: Oven, grill and hood cleaner.

dilutionGuidance.note: Spray, leave for a few seconds, then rub. Wear appropriate PPE.
